subject: Center for Citizenship and Social Responsibility Report
overview: The committee approved an after-school math tutoring program for the Columbus School and received a comprehensive report on student-led community service projects. Members also addressed school security upgrades, building funding, and concerns regarding student vaping and bus safety.

items.title: Ceremonial Holiday Music and Recognition
items.summary: The Fine Arts Department performed holiday music and the committee recognized a donation of drumsticks and lighting equipment.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes of the December 4 meeting.

items.title: Bills, Transfers, and Payrolls
items.summary: Approved the bills, transfers of funds, and payrolls after confirming the propriety of student activity account charges.

items.title: Report of the Committee of the Whole
items.summary: Received a report on the December 11 meeting regarding the superintendent search, including the appointment of a subcommittee to draft candidate materials.

items.title: Columbus School Math Tutoring Program
items.summary: Approved an $11,200 program for 16 weeks of after-school math tutoring and transportation for students in grades 3-5 at the Columbus School.

items.title: Robotics Club Donation
items.summary: Accepted a donation from Dr. Banshaw to support the Medford High School Robotics Club competition team.

items.title: Center for Citizenship and Social Responsibility (CCSR) Report
items.summary: Received a report on a $100,000 Cummings Foundation grant supporting student initiatives, including hurricane relief, language support for English learners, and empowerment workshops.

items.title: MSBA Statement of Interest Update
items.summary: Noted that the MSBA did not select Medford's current application for funding and authorized a new submission for the April core program cycle.

items.title: Security Cameras Report
items.summary: Approved a report on $200,000 in camera upgrades and scheduled a January Committee of the Whole meeting to discuss security protocols in executive session.

items.title: School Lunch Charge Policy
items.summary: Referred a draft lunch charge policy back for revision to investigate federal requirements for alternative meals for students with negative balances.

items.title: High School Bus Incident and Safety Update
items.summary: Implemented changes to bus pickup locations at the high school following a student injury incident on December 15.

items.title: Student Vaping Concerns
items.summary: Discussed the prevalence of vaping and scheduled a parent educational forum for February 8.

items.title: Tributes to Outgoing Members
items.summary: Recognized Ann Marie Cugno and Robert Skerry for their years of service on the School Committee.
